import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# In obs_0057: cam at (-1.62, 1.65), heading = 45 deg
img57 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0057.png')

# 1. Chair on the left:
# Legs bottom:
chair57 = (img57[:,:,2] > 100) & (img57[:,:,2] < 160) & (img57[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 200)
yc, xc = np.where(chair57)
print('Chair in obs_0057: bottom y =', yc.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xc))
# Let's find the 4 leg bottoms:
# front left leg, front right leg
leg_bottoms = yc[yc > 380]
print('Chair leg bottom max:', yc.max())
wx_ch, wy_ch, z_ch = ray_ground(np.mean(xc), yc.max(), -1.62, 1.65, 45)
print(f'Chair: ({wx_ch:.2f}, {wy_ch:.2f}), dist={z_ch:.2f}')

# 2. Floor lamp base:
# Dark circular base:
lamp57 = (img57[:,:,0] > 60) & (img57[:,:,0] < 90) & (img57[:,:,1] > 60) & (img57[:,:,1] < 90) & (img57[:,:,2] > 60) & (img57[:,:,2] < 90) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 360)
yl, xl = np.where(lamp57)
print('Lamp in obs_0057: bottom y =', yl.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xl))
wx_lp, wy_lp, z_lp = ray_ground(np.mean(xl), yl.max(), -1.62, 1.65, 45)
print(f'Lamp: ({wx_lp:.2f}, {wy_lp:.2f}), dist={z_lp:.2f}')

# 3. Stool:
# In the center background
stool57 = (img57[:,:,2] > 100) & (img57[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 300)
yst, xst = np.where(stool57)
print('Stool in obs_0057: bottom y =', yst.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xst))
wx_st, wy_st, z_st = ray_ground(np.mean(xst), yst.max(), -1.62, 1.65, 45)
print(f'Stool: ({wx_st:.2f}, {wy_st:.2f}), dist={z_st:.2f}')

# 4. Cabinet / credenza:
cred57 = (img57[:,:,0] > 120) & (img57[:,:,1] > 150) & (img57[:,:,2] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 300) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 400)
ycr, xcr = np.where(cred57)
print('Credenza in obs_0057: bottom y =', ycr.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xcr))
wx_cr, wy_cr, z_cr = ray_ground(np.mean(xcr), ycr.max(), -1.62, 1.65, 45)
print(f'Credenza: ({wx_cr:.2f}, {wy_cr:.2f}), dist={z_cr:.2f}')

# 5. Table (partially visible on right):
tbl57 = (img57[:,:,2] > 80) & (img57[:,:,2] < 150) & (img57[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 450)
ytb, xtb = np.where(tbl57)
print('Table leg in obs_0057: bottom y =', ytb.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xtb))

print(f'Table leg: ({wx_tb:.2f}, {wy_tb:.2f}), dist={z_tb:.2f}')
